sentences.text: Cecil Louis Troughton Smith -LRB- 27 August 1899 -- 2 April 1966 -RRB- , known by his pen name Cecil Scott `` C. S. '' Forester , was an English novelist known for writing tales of naval warfare such as the 12-book Horatio Hornblower series , depicting a Royal Navy officer during the Napoleonic wars .	naval warfare	naval warfare	Horatio Hornblower	Horatio Hornblower	Royal Navy	Royal Navy	Napoleonic wars	Napoleonic wars
